when.test: tabType == 'active' and (strategyClass == "升接" or strategyClass == "稳" or strategyClass == "降拆" or strategyClass == "离" or strategyClass == "重点客群")
tabType == 'active' and (strategyClass == "升接" or strategyClass == "稳" or strategyClass == "降拆" or strategyClass == "离" or strategyClass == "重点客群")

choose.when: (SELECT id, strategy_id, stat_month, reason_code, reason_name, reject_count, reject_ratio, color, sort_no, city_id, county_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM t_sr_strategy_reject_reason UNION ALL SELECT id, strategy_id, stat_month, reason_code, reason_name, reject_count, reject_ratio, color, sort_no, city_id, county_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM t_sr_strategy_reject_reason_special UNION ALL SELECT id, strategy_id, stat_month, reason_code, reason_name, reject_count, reject_ratio, color, sort_no, city_id, county_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM t_sr_strategy_reject_reason_key_audience)

when.test: query.tabType == 'active' and query.customerGroup != null and query.customerGroup != ''
query.tabType == 'active' and (query.strategyClass == null or query.strategyClass == '' or query.strategyClass == '全部')

choose.otherwise: SELECT d.key_code AS keyCode, d.key_name AS keyName FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{query.tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{query.tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0) ORDER BY d.sort_no, d.key_code

choose.when:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS keyCode, MAX(s.strategy_name) AS keyName FROM s WHERE s.tab_type = 'active' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.strategy_id != '999' AND s.strategy_name IS NOT NULL AND s.stat_month = (SELECT MAX(latest.stat_month) FROM latest WHERE latest.tab_type = 'active' AND latest.is_deleted = 0
AND latest.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND latest.strategy_class IN ('升接', '稳', '重点客群') )
AND (s.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(s.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0)))
AND 1 = 0
AND s.strategy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND s.strategy_class IN ('升接', '稳', '重点客群')
GROUP BY s.strategy_id ORDER BY keyName LIMIT 10
choose.otherwise:
SELECT t.strategy_code AS keyCode, t.strategy_name AS keyName FROM t WHERE t.tab_type = #{tabType} AND t.is_deleted = 0
AND (t.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(t.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0)))
AND 1 = 0
AND t.strategy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 10

mapper.select: SELECT m.metric_code AS keyCode, m.metric_name AS keyName FROM t_sr_dim_metric m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND (m.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, m.tab_type) > 0) ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.metric_code

SELECT CASE k.metric_code WHEN 'PUSH_CNT' THEN 'push_count' WHEN 'USAGE_CNT' THEN 'usage_count' WHEN 'REAL_INCOME' THEN 'actual_income' WHEN 'ALL_PRODUCT_CONV_RATE' THEN 'product_conv_rate' WHEN 'ALL_PRODUCT_CONV_CNT' THEN 'product_conv_num' WHEN 'STRATEGY_CNT' THEN 'strategy_count' WHEN 'REACH_CNT' THEN 'reach_count' ELSE k.metric_code END AS metricCode, k.metric_name AS label, k.value AS value, k.unit AS unit, k.qoq AS trendQoQ, k.yoy AS trendYoY, k.icon AS icon, k.sort_no AS sortNo FROM k WHERE k.tab_type = #{tabType} AND REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{statMonth}, '-', '') AND k.is_deleted = 0
AND k.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND k.strategy_class = '全部'
ORDER BY k.sort_no, k.id

SELECT REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') AS month, k.value AS value, k.qoq AS qoq, k.unit AS unit FROM k WHERE k.tab_type = #{tabType} AND CASE k.metric_code WHEN 'PUSH_CNT' THEN 'push_count' WHEN 'USAGE_CNT' THEN 'usage_count' WHEN 'REAL_INCOME' THEN 'actual_income' WHEN 'ALL_PRODUCT_CONV_RATE' THEN 'product_conv_rate' WHEN 'ALL_PRODUCT_CONV_CNT' THEN 'product_conv_num' WHEN 'STRATEGY_CNT' THEN 'strategy_count' WHEN 'REACH_CNT' THEN 'reach_count' ELSE k.metric_code END = #{metricCode} AND k.is_deleted = 0
AND k.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND k.strategy_class = '全部'
AND REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') <= REPLACE(#{statMonth}, '-', '')
ORDER BY k.stat_month DESC LIMIT 12

choose.when:
SELECT c.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, c.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, c.strategy_count AS strategyCount, c.strategy_count_qoq AS strategyCountQoQ, c.original_cust AS originalCust, c.original_cust_qoq AS originalCustQoQ, c.push_count AS pushCount, c.push_count_qoq AS pushCountQoQ, c.usage_count AS usageCount, c.usage_count_qoq AS usageCountQoQ, c.usage_rate AS usageRate, c.usage_rate_qoq AS usageRateQoQ, c.reach_count AS reachCount, c.reach_count_qoq AS reachCountQoQ, c.reach_rate AS reachRate, c.reach_rate_qoq AS reachRateQoQ, c.target_conv_num AS targetConvNum, c.target_conv_num_qoq AS targetConvNumQoQ, c.target_conv_rate AS targetConvRate, c.target_conv_rate_qoq AS targetConvRateQoQ, c.product_conv_num AS productConvNum, c.product_conv_num_qoq AS productConvNumQoQ, c.product_conv_rate AS productConvRate, c.product_conv_rate_qoq AS productConvRateQoQ, c.expected_income AS expectedIncome, c.expected_income_qoq AS expectedIncomeQoQ, c.actual_income AS actualIncome, c.actual_income_qoq AS actualIncomeQoQ FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap c LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = c.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE c.tab_type = 'active' AND c.strategy_class = #{strategyClass} AND c.strategy_id = '999' AND DATE_FORMAT(c.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = #{statMonth} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.big_category = '全部' AND COALESCE(c.small_category, '') = '全部'
AND (c.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(c.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d2.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d2 WHERE d2.key_name = #{channel} AND d2.status = 1 AND d2.is_deleted = 0 AND (d2.tab_type = 'active' OR FIND_IN_SET('active', d2.tab_type) > 0) ))
AND c.channel = '全部' AND c.channel != '全部'
AND c.city_id = #{cityId} AND c.city_id = '999'
AND c.county_id = #{countyId} ORDER BY
${orderByClause} c.strategy_count DESC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT c.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, c.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, c.strategy_count AS strategyCount, c.strategy_count_qoq AS strategyCountQoQ, c.original_cust AS originalCust, c.original_cust_qoq AS originalCustQoQ, c.push_count AS pushCount, c.push_count_qoq AS pushCountQoQ, c.usage_count AS usageCount, c.usage_count_qoq AS usageCountQoQ, c.usage_rate AS usageRate, c.usage_rate_qoq AS usageRateQoQ, c.reach_count AS reachCount, c.reach_count_qoq AS reachCountQoQ,
c.reach_rate AS reachRate, c.reach_rate_qoq AS reachRateQoQ,
c.target_conv_num AS targetConvNum, c.target_conv_num_qoq AS targetConvNumQoQ, c.target_conv_rate AS targetConvRate, c.target_conv_rate_qoq AS targetConvRateQoQ, c.product_conv_num AS productConvNum, c.product_conv_num_qoq AS productConvNumQoQ, c.product_conv_rate AS productConvRate, c.product_conv_rate_qoq AS productConvRateQoQ, c.expected_income AS expectedIncome, c.expected_income_qoq AS expectedIncomeQoQ, c.actual_income AS actualIncome, c.actual_income_qoq AS actualIncomeQoQ FROM c LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = c.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE c.tab_type = #{tabType} AND DATE_FORMAT(c.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = #{statMonth} AND c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND c.strategy_class = '全部'
AND c.city_id = #{cityId}
AND (c.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(c.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0)))
AND c.channel !='全部'
AND c.county_id = #{countyId}
ORDER BY
${orderByClause} c.strategy_count DESC

mapper.sql:
AND s.channel != '全部' AND s.big_category != '全部' AND COALESCE(s.small_category, '') != '全部' AND s.strategy_name != '全部' AND s.strategy_id != '999'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_sr_strategy_read product WHERE product.strategy_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = s.strategy_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND product.tab_type = 'control' AND product.is_deleted = 0)
AND (s.strategy_class IS NULL OR s.strategy_class != '全部')
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory
FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s
FROM s
ORDER BY s.big_category, s.small_category

choose.when:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS strategyId, s.strategy_code AS strategyCode, s.strategy_name AS strategyName, s.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, s.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, s.push_count AS consultCount, s.push_count_qoq AS consultCountQoQ, s.usage_count AS retainCount, s.usage_count_qoq AS retainCountQoQ, s.usage_rate AS retainRate, s.usage_rate_qoq AS retainRateQoQ, s.reach_count AS dispatchCount, s.reach_count_qoq AS dispatchCountQoQ, s.product_conv_num AS successCount, s.product_conv_num_qoq AS successCountQoQ, s.product_conv_rate AS successRate, s.product_conv_rate_qoq AS successRateQoQ, s.actual_income AS income, s.actual_income_qoq AS incomeQoQ FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = s.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ORDER BY
${orderByClause} s.product_conv_num DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS strategyId, s.strategy_name AS strategyName, s.strategy_class AS strategyClass, s.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, s.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, s.original_cust AS originalCust, s.original_cust_qoq AS originalCustQoQ, s.push_count AS pushCount, s.push_count_qoq AS pushCountQoQ, s.usage_count AS usageCount, s.usage_count_qoq AS usageCountQoQ, s.usage_rate AS usageRate, s.usage_rate_qoq AS usageRateQoQ, s.reach_count AS reachCount, s.reach_count_qoq AS reachCountQoQ, s.target_conv_num AS targetConvNum, s.target_conv_num_qoq AS targetConvNumQoQ, s.target_conv_rate AS targetConvRate, s.target_conv_rate_qoq AS targetConvRateQoQ, s.product_conv_num AS productConvNum, s.product_conv_num_qoq AS productConvNumQoQ, s.product_conv_rate AS productConvRate, s.product_conv_rate_qoq AS productConvRateQoQ, s.expected_income AS expectedIncome, s.expected_income_qoq AS expectedIncomeQoQ, s.actual_income AS actualIncome, s.actual_income_qoq AS actualIncomeQoQ, s.reject_rate AS rejectRate, s.reject_rate_qoq AS rejectRateQoQ, s.reject_count AS rejectCount FROM s LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = s.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ORDER BY
${orderByClause} s.product_conv_num DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.when:
SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(REPLACE(CAST(m.stat_month AS CHAR), '-', ''), 4), '-', SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(m.stat_month AS CHAR), '-', ''), 5, 2)) AS month, m.capacity AS capacity, m.qoq AS qoq FROM t_sr_channel_monthly_capacity_ap m WHERE m.tab_type = 'active' AND m.strategy_class = #{strategyClass} AND m.is_deleted = 0
AND REPLACE(LEFT(CAST(m.stat_month AS CHAR), 7), '-', '') <= REPLACE(#{statMonth}, '-', '')
AND (m.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(m.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = 'active' OR FIND_IN_SET('active', d.tab_type) > 0)))
AND m.channel = '全部'
AND m.big_category = #{bigCategory} AND m.big_category = '全部'
AND m.small_category = #{smallCategory} AND m.small_category = '全部'
AND m.city_id = #{cityId} AND m.city_id = '999'
AND m.county_id = #{countyId} ORDER BY m.stat_month DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT p.strategy_id AS strategyId, t.strategy_code AS strategyCode, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS strategyName, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS name, t.strategy_level AS level, t.caliber AS caliber, t.iteration AS iteration, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, t.owner AS owner, t.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, p.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, p.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, p.big_category AS bigCategory, p.small_category AS smallCategory FROM ( SELECT strategy_id, strategy_name, channel, big_category, small_category FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND channel!='全部'
AND (channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0)))
ORDER BY stat_month DESC LIMIT 1 ) p LEFT JOIN v_sr_strategy_read t ON t.strategy_code = #{strategyId} AND t.tab_type = 'control' AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise:
SELECT p.strategy_id AS strategyId, t.strategy_code AS strategyCode, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS strategyName, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS name, t.strategy_level AS level, t.caliber AS caliber, t.iteration AS iteration, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, t.owner AS owner, t.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, p.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, p.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS channelName, p.big_category AS bigCategory, p.small_category AS smallCategory FROM ( SELECT strategy_id, strategy_name, channel, big_category, small_category FROM WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (tab_type = #{tabType} OR tab_type IS NULL) AND channel != '全部' AND big_category != '全部' AND COALESCE(small_category, '') != '全部'
AND (strategy_class IS NULL OR strategy_class != '全部')
AND strategy_class IN ('升接', '稳', '重点客群')
AND channel = #{channel}
ORDER BY stat_month DESC, channel, big_category, small_category LIMIT 1 ) p LEFT JOIN t ON t.strategy_code = #{strategyId} AND t.tab_type = #{tabType} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.channel COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1

AND (s.channel = #{channel} OR CONVERT(s.channel USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT CONVERT(d.key_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.key_name = #{channel} AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = 'passive' OR FIND_IN_SET('passive', d.tab_type) > 0) ))
